title: [ENG] RS0371's Slaanesh's Image and Text 1.0.0
author: AMchi
description:
So, a while back there was a mod uploaded here that changed a bunch of banners and building icons into lewd images. What it also came with was a bunch text that altered descriptions of buildings to make them a little more... Slaaneshi. Problem is, all of it was in CN, which made it kind of inaccessible.

I felt like it was a pretty good addition to a lewd campaign of WH3 (especially for campaigns with the Goblin Horde mod active) so I decided to bite the bullet and translate the text into English. Pretty much all of what is present in this translation was run through translation software and pasted raw (I swear I was editing at least the first hundred or so entries properly, I mostly got worn down over time -_-), but it's mostly intelligible.

Give me like a few days (or maybe a week or two) and I might go ahead and properly edit the flavor text. If I really feel motivated (unlikely since I've barely touched the game since Goblin Horde stopped active development), I'll expand the mod.

The mod is standalone; just drop the .pack file into your data folder, and enable it in the launcher.

All credit for the mod goes to RS0371.

Link to the CN version of the mod that was uploaded on LL here:

<https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/33?tab=description>

The mod requires both "Immortal Landmarks" (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2854346056 <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2854346056)>) and "Landmarks of Legend" (<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794696516>) or else you'll get a CTD.
